PDF Cropper

🤖 Cut lines are detected automatically: each page is scanned row by row, and lines land in the middle of the gaps between staff systems

🖱 Click to add a line, drag to move it; ❌ double-click a line, press Delete/Backspace, or use the ✕ button to remove it

🎚 Tune White sensitivity if your PDF has cream/yellowish paper instead of pure white

👁 Uncheck Render cut overlay to preview the simulated cropped result before downloading

➡ Use the navigation bar or the keyboard left/right arrows to change pages
